records.issue_text: [High/security] app/models/post.rb:131 — The `raw_html` cook method returns `raw` verbatim, completely bypassing Discourse's cooking/sanitization pipeline, and imported content is later rendered with `raw post.cooked`; any HTML pulled from the RSS feed or a remote page (script tags, event handlers, `javascript:` hrefs — readability only whitelists tags/attrs, it doesn't sanitize schemes) is stored as live markup that executes on the Discourse origin for every user who views the topic. Imported remote content must be run through the normal Sanitize pipeline before being stored in `cooked`.
records.rationale: The diff shows post.cook returns raw verbatim for raw_html cook method, bypassing sanitization, and TopicEmbed.import stores remote RSS/scraped content with cook_method: raw_html, rendered later via `raw post.cooked`. Readability whitelists tags/attributes but doesn't sanitize URL schemes, so injected HTML from remote feeds would execute on the Discourse origin. Mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
